message.content: {"action":"switch_architecture","reason":"The symmetric_preadd structure at coef_frac=15, rounding=rne achieves the same analytic error energy and SQNR as the direct structure (1.483, 85.14 dB) while reducing mapped area from 12782.9 to 8520.2 um^2, giving the best numerical-quality-per-area tradeoff observed. Switching architecture has one legal unvisited neighbor and is the only action that can still improve area without sacrificing precision, whereas decreasing precision would degrade SQNR to ~78.7 dB and increasing precision is unavailable."}
